entities.name: Tatyova
entities.description: Merfolk druid of Dominaria from the Voda Sea who studied druidry in Yavimaya and returned to Vodalia, where she moderates Emperor Mihail II.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Forested realm where Tatyova studied druidic arts.

entities.name: Emperor Mihail II
entities.description: Merfolk ruler whose aggressive tendencies Tatyova moderates.

events.summary: Tatyova left the Voda Sea to pursue druidic studies in Yavimaya.
events.quote: Tatyova left her aquatic homeland to pursue druidic studies in the forested realm of Yavimaya

events.summary: Tatyova returned to Vodalia after her apprenticeship with the elves of Yavimaya.
events.quote: Tatyova returned to her people in the underwater domain of Vodalia

relations.note: She moderates his more aggressive tendencies.
relations.quote: moderating Emperor Mihail II ’s more aggressive tendencies
